specs.title: Weekly WhatsApp digest
specs.why: A weekly summary keeps the merchant engaged and surfaces problems they would not otherwise notice.
specs.scope: Every Sunday at 18:00 tenant-local, send the owner a summary: bookings count, revenue, no-shows, top service and one actionable insight.
acceptance: The digest is sent to every active tenant weekly
Numbers match the dashboard for the same period
The insight generator produces one actionable item per tenant

specs.title: Staff accounts and assignment
specs.why: Multi-staff businesses are a large share of the target market and need per-staff calendars.
specs.scope: Multi-staff tenants: per-staff calendars, per-staff service eligibility, commission split on payout. Booking flow lets the client pick a staff member where enabled.
tasks: Staff picker in the public flow
Commission field on Staff and payout split
acceptance: Staff see only their own bookings
Commission is reflected in the ledger
The double-book constraint applies per staff
